the title block.

The first draft 
initiated by eng. Mohamed Atya Mahmoud El Egamy, tested by eng. 
Mohamed Ahmed Ezzy at 08 August 2005, revised by EDEPC quality 
control eng. Abd Elmineem Atya, accepted by 
eng. Mahmoud Abdel-Hade 
Ahmed Hurgada 
PS general director.

eng. Samir 
Abd El Gilil: EDEPC MPIS Coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman admin & financial inspection quality control general director

items:
A work permit must be issued ,the maintenance staff should 
 be qualified and carry the suitable safety category .

Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Switch off all CB's on the motor control center (MCC)

Select "DATA" list 16, 
 logic forcing and enter logic signals L14HR, L14HM, L14HA and L14HS on the CRT 
 display

Slowly increase the oscillator frequency from zero and verify that the zero 
 speed logic L14HR resets to logic "0" at the dropout speed given in the 
 control spec. setting adjust from constant TNK 14HR if dropout does not 
 occur at the correct speed.

Slowly decrease the oscillator frequency and verify that the zero speed logic 
 L14HR goes to a logic "1" at the pickup speed given in the control spec. setting adjust from constant TNK 14HR if correction is required.

Continue to increase the oscillator frequency and verify that all of the 
 other speed logic signals change to a logic "1" at the pickup speed listed in 
 the control spec. setting . adjust corresponding from constants listed if 
 required as shown in table (1).

Slowly decrease the oscillator frequency from full speed and verify that all 
 of the speed logic signals resets to a logic "0" at the dropout speed listed 
 in the control spec. setting adjust corresponding from constants listed if 
 required.

Safety Precautions
Unit at shut down mode.
A work permit must be issued ,the maintenance staff should 
 be qualified and carry the suitable safety category .
Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Switch off all CB's on the motor control center (MCC)
Tools and Equipment
Test oscillator,
 test counter.
Screw driver,
 Jumpers.
Work to be Carried Out
NAME | K VALUE | UNITS | DESCRIPTION
TNK 14 HA1 | K 51.000 | % SPD | L14HA PICKUP (ACCELLERATE)
TNK 14 HA2 | K 47.100 | % SPD | L14HA DROPOUT (SHUTDOWN)
TNK 14 HM1 | K 18.000 | % SPD | L14HM PICKUP (MIN. FIRE)
TNK 14 HM2 | K 17.000 | % SPD | L14HM
 DROPOUT 
 (FIRING SPEED)
TNK 14 HR1 | K 0.060 | % SPD | L14HR PICKUP 3+2 RPM (ZERO SPD)
TNK 14 HR2 | K 0.310 | % SPD | L14HR DROPOUT 16+4 RPM
TNK 14 HS1 | K 95.000 | % SPD | L14HS PICKUP (OPERATING)
TNK 14 HS2 | K 87.400 | % SPD | L14HS DROPOUT (UNDER FREQ.)
Select "DATA" list 16, 
 logic forcing and enter logic signals L14HR, L14HM, L14HA and L14HS on the CRT 
 display
Slowly increase the oscillator frequency from zero and verify that the zero 
 speed logic L14HR resets to logic "0" at the dropout speed given in the 
 control spec. setting adjust from constant TNK 14HR if dropout does not 
 occur at the correct speed.
Slowly decrease the oscillator frequency and verify that the zero speed logic 
 L14HR goes to a logic "1" at the pickup speed given in the control spec. setting adjust from constant TNK 14HR if correction is required.
Continue to increase the oscillator frequency and verify that all of the 
 other speed logic signals change to a logic "1" at the pickup speed listed in 
 the control spec. setting . adjust corresponding from constants listed if 
 required as shown in table (1).
Slowly decrease the oscillator frequency from full speed and verify that all 
 of the speed logic signals resets to a logic "0" at the dropout speed listed 
 in the control spec. setting adjust corresponding from constants listed if 
 required.
